email_body:
Dear R3AL.AI team,

I'm applying for the Junior BDR role. Your mission to help organizations own their intelligence resonates with me, especially as someone who uses AI daily and understands the importance of data privacy.

My background is in digital marketing and web development, where I've built and optimized websites, run SEO campaigns, and used AI tools to automate work. I haven't done cold calling professionally, but I've consistently had to win people over—whether it was convincing clients to adopt SEO strategies or building my own freelance business from scratch. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with basic Dutch, and I'm eager to learn sales the hard way.

I'm drawn to the early-stage, hands-on environment at R3AL.AI. I want to be one of the first people shaping how you go to market, and I'm ready to put in the calls every day. I'm based in Belgium and open to remote or hybrid work.

I'd love to discuss how my hustle and interest in AI can contribute to your outbound engine.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear R3AL.AI team,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior BDR position. When I read that you're helping organizations own their intelligence—keeping sensitive data on their own infrastructure—I knew I had to reach out. As someone who uses AI tools daily and builds websites with a focus on data privacy and search visibility, I see the problem you're solving firsthand.

My experience isn't in traditional sales, but it's built on winning people over. As a freelance digital marketer, I've had to convince clients to invest in SEO, explain technical concepts in plain language, and deliver results that speak for themselves. I've built and optimized websites for clients in Belgium and abroad, using AI to automate repetitive work and improve efficiency. I'm comfortable with outreach across email and LinkedIn, and I'm not afraid to pick up the phone—though I'm eager to learn the art of cold calling from the ground up.

What draws me to R3AL.AI is the early-stage, build-it-with-us mentality. I want to be the first person making those 80-100 calls a day, learning the pitch inside out, and helping shape how you go to market. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with basic Dutch, and I'm based in Belgium. I'm driven by results, not hours, and I thrive on feedback and fast learning.

I understand this role is about hustle and mindset. I'm ready to bring both. I'd love the chance to discuss how my background in digital marketing and AI can translate into booked meetings for your founder.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
